info.title: eCFR Universal API
info.description: Access the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, including title metadata, agency metadata, search results, corrections, version history, structure, ancestry, and full title content from the public eCFR API.

get.description: Retrieves the count of search results from eCFR.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Search query text to count.
